I wrote the spoken reply to `reply.txt` in this folder. It lists her tools in plain sentences, with no links or formatting, so a text-to-speech engine can read it aloud:

> Shauna mostly works with Claude Code and Figma. For building the site she uses Astro, React, and TypeScript. Supabase handles the data side, and she deploys with Vercel and Netlify. If you want, I can tell you how the design system ties those together.

The tool list comes from the Tools section of `FACTS.md`, the only file in the folder with content. `prompt.txt` just repeats the task. `session.json` and `session.err` are both empty. There was no separate spoken-reply rules file here, so I kept it short and conversational by judgment.

The line about Supabase handling "the data side" is my wording, not something `FACTS.md` says. The file only lists Supabase as a tool.
